Label: Grade 8 English Language Arts and Literacy
Description: Strongest textual evidence, theme/central idea, point of view, text structure, argument evaluation, claims/reasons/evidence, vocabulary/morphology, grammar, speaking/listening, research, writing, revision, media, and disciplinary literacy.

Label: Grade 8 Mathematics and Algebra I Readiness
Description: Expressions/equations, systems, functions, linear relationships, slope/intercept, exponents, scientific notation, transformations, congruence, similarity, Pythagorean theorem, volume, bivariate data, statistics, and modeling.

Label: Middle School Culminating Science and Engineering
Description: Matter, chemical reactions, forces, energy, waves, Earth/space systems, geologic time, fossils, evolution evidence, genetics, ecosystems, sustainability, engineering design, models, data analysis, and CER reasoning.

Label: Grade 8 Social Studies, Civics, and History
Description: Geography, founding ideas, constitutional principles, rights/responsibilities, revolution, civic design, expansion, reform, Civil War/Reconstruction foundations, economics, source analysis, perspective, and informed action.

Label: World Languages and Global Culture
Description: Language learning foundations, scripts, grammar patterns, cognates, cultural protocol, translation awareness, geography of languages, diplomacy, respect, and global communication.

Label: Arts, Music, and Media
Description: Creative process, visual design, media arts, music literacy, rhythm, melody, drama, performance, critique, cultural arts, artist statements, and high-school portfolio curation.

Label: Health, PE, and SEL
Description: Physical literacy, fitness planning, nutrition, safety, adolescent wellness, stress management, executive function, conflict resolution, leadership, resilience, digital wellness, and self-advocacy.

Label: Technology, Design, and AI-Readiness Tools
Description: Digital citizenship, file systems, spreadsheets, charts, source notes, ethical media, algorithms, debugging, accessibility, data ethics, AI-readiness habits, and presentation systems.

Label: Integrated A++ High School Readiness Projects
Description: Cross-disciplinary inquiry, evidence gathering, data analysis, algebraic modeling, research writing, scientific/civic modeling, design, revision, oral defense, portfolio, and reflection.

Label: Portfolio, Assessment, and High School Readiness
Description: Weekly mastery, performance tasks, midterm, final, capstone checkpoints, student reflection, teacher evidence, family reports, high school transition planning, and 80% certification.
